overview: Priya finished the billing Postgres 16 migration and will write a rollback runbook. Marcus shipped the checkout address form at 5% and will pair with Diego on flaky checkout tests. Aisha is blocked on private endpoint DNS in staging and will open an Azure support ticket. The team decided to drop the Redis cache for session lookups. Diego is blocked on SSO test accounts.

topics.title: Billing Postgres 16 migration
topics.summary: Cutover completed; old cluster goes read-only Monday.

topics.title: Staging private endpoint DNS
topics.summary: Container apps can't resolve the Postgres private endpoint.

topics.title: Redis cache for sessions
topics.summary: Load test showed p99 of 4 ms on Postgres alone.

decisions.decision: Drop the Redis cache for session lookups and read from Postgres directly
decisions.rationale: Load test p99 was 4 ms at double peak traffic; one less service to operate. Revisit if production p99 exceeds 20 ms.
